text:
emma_cs: Hey team — prepping Lumenix QBR next week. I pulled a quick spend snapshot and we have a 3x embeddings spike in the last 7 days. Need a short triage + action list for cost + enablement before the exec readout.
jon_eng: Ugh, embeddings again. Any idea if it's a model change or customer behavior?
emma_cs: Initial look: traffic pattern shows a new scheduled job hitting /v1/embeddings every 6h. Could be a batch job they flipped on.
lia_fin: Numbers? want to flag renewal risk if they overshoot committed credits.
emma_cs: Quick figures from billing-bot: total tokens last 7d = 1,820,450 tokens, embeddings units ~ 220k requests, projected month = ~7.9M tokens at current rate. If they have a fixed commit of 3M, we'll need mitigation.
billing-bot: [automated] Account Lumenix: 7-day tokens=1820450, monthly projection=7924100, commit=3000000 (from contract), threshold_alert=true
maria_enablement: I can prepare an enablement note for their SRE/ML team with suggestions: reduce embedding dimension? reuse cached vectors? batch requests? Also a quick runbook to throttle non-critical jobs.
rahul_se: From SE side I can reach out to the customer's infra lead — ask for run schedule + whether they recently rolled a new pipeline. Also propose: route lower-priority jobs to a quantized smaller model.
jon_eng: Technical actions we can propose: 1) enable prefix KV caching for repeated texts 2) recommend 8-bit quantized embedding model (if quality ok) 3) advise on batching to reduce requests per embedding. I'll draft short config snippets.
emma_cs: Lia — could you estimate burn impact under two mitigations: (A) 30% reduction via batching/cache, (B) 60% reduction via batching+quantized model? We need numbers for the QBR slide.
lia_fin: On it. Quick math: projected 7.9M tokens. A: 7.9M * 0.7 = 5.53M tokens. B: 7.9M * 0.4 = 3.16M tokens. If commit=3M, A still over by ~2.53M, B roughly within commit but close. I'll add $ estimates.
maria_enablement: Drafting the enablement doc now. Will include sample batching header and a one-page checklist.
jon_eng: Sample config snippet (for their orchestrator):
```
# pseudocode
batcher.max_batch_tokens = 4096
embeddings.batch_size = 64
cache.prefix_ttl = 86400  # 24h
```

jon_eng: Also include a snippet for fallbacks: route to cheaper model during non-peak windows.
emma_cs: Nice. Stakeholders: Lumenix CSM + infra lead — I'll ask for a 20-min sync. Can someone own the outreach?
rahul_se: I'll own outreach. DM'ing infra lead and cc'ing emma_cs.
lia_fin: I'll put the cost delta in a small table for the QBR slide and note renewal risk flag if no mitigation within 2 weeks.
billing-bot: [automated] Created alert: account=Lumenix, alert_type=spend_projection_high, notify_channel=#customer-success, severity=warning
emma_cs: Agenda for sync: 1) show projected run rate and commit gap 2) propose quick mitigations (batch/cache/quantized) 3) action plan + owners 4) follow-up in 48h.
maria_enablement: Will upload the one-pager and a short playbook into the enablement drive and share link here before EOD.
jon_eng: Quick ask — do we want to recommend a canary for model swap? e.g., 10% traffic for 24h to check quality before broad quantized rollout.
emma_cs: Yes include canary plan in playbook. Also add rollback triggers: #errors > 1% or quality metric delta > 5%.
rahul_se: Sync scheduled: Thu 10:00am. I'll send meeting invite.
lia_fin: Final ask for the QBR slide deck: please send me the short bullets + numbers by Wed noon so I can assemble.
emma_cs: Great — owners: rahul (outreach + meeting), jon (tech snippets + canary plan), maria (enablement doc), lia (cost delta + slide). I'll consolidate notes and tag exec summary. Thanks :thumbsup:
maria_enablement: Uploaded draft: https://drive.internal/r/enablement/lumenix-qbr-onepager — feedback welcome :mag:
emma_cs: Got it. I'll review and add exec summary.
jon_eng: Quick follow-up: SQL to pull per-job embeddings volume for their project (send to rahul):
```
SELECT job_name, count(*) as reqs, sum(tokens) as tokens
FROM api_events
WHERE account_id = 'acct_oggLumenix'
AND event_type = 'embedding.create'
AND timestamp >= now() - interval '7 days'
GROUP BY job_name
ORDER BY tokens DESC;
```

rahul_se: Received. Sending to infra lead now.
lia_fin: I'll produce two slide variants: conservative & optimistic. Sending drafts by Wed.
emma_cs: OK team — let's reconvene after the customer sync and finalize QBR numbers. Appreciate the quick turnaround.
jon_eng: :rocket:
rahul_se: on it.
maria_enablement: :white_check_mark:
